entries._comment: PANGENOME needs a per-window SUBGRAPH: the full chr21.gfa (~719MB, whole chromosome) OOMs in graph tokenization (every node padded to the longest -> 37TB). This is the HPRC window subgraph covering chr21:5000056-5555548 (population graph, sample-agnostic; same data/chr21/HG002/pangenome_windows/*.gfa the HG005 pangenome_windows manifest uses for HG005 reads). 26800 x ~249bp / 555492 ~= 12x. TRAIN/VAL 80/20; the held-out TEST is a DISJOINT window -> hg005_chr21_shortread_pango.test.json.
